title: Bangkok Khlong (Canal) Boat Tour
description: Escape the concrete jungle on a private longtail boat, navigating the intricate network of canals in Thonburi to see the 'Venice of the East' as it looked.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Bangkok Khlong (Canal) Boat Tour" is a 3-hour private longtail boat experience in Thonburi, focusing on the western side of the Chao Phraya river to showcase traditional, water-based Bangkok life. This tour offers a nostalgic and eye-opening atmosphere, with low physical demand.
> *   Key itinerary stops include an orchid farm or the Artist's House (Baan Silapin) for a traditional puppet show, providing cultural immersion. The tour is available year-round, but advance booking is strictly required.
> *   Booking through Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) ensures priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers, bypassing logistical friction. This experience is best paired with a relaxing afternoon before an evening dinner cruise.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Escape the concrete jungle on a private longtail boat, navigating the intricate network of canals in Thonburi to see the 'Venice of the East' as it looked a century ago.

## The Operator & Origin Story
While the eastern side of the Chao Phraya river was paved over for modern development, the western side (Thonburi) retains its massive network of khlongs. It provides a stark look at the traditional, water-based lifestyle of working-class Bangkok.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Board a traditional teak longtail boat at a central pier. As you cross into the Thonburi canals, the roar of the city vanishes. 

You glide past wooden stilted houses, floating kitchens, and small ornate temples. You will see massive monitor lizards sunning themselves on the banks and children jumping into the water. The tour typically stops at an orchid farm or the spectacular Artist's House (Baan Silapin) for a traditional puppet show.

## Zero-Walking Afternoon Recovery Along Thonburi’s Teak Canals After Morning Golf
When your fourball tees off at 07:00 AM at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or [Nikanti Golf Club](/courses/thailand/nikanti/) and returns to [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/) or [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) by 1:00 PM, the last thing most players want at 3:00 PM is a three-hour walking tour on hot pavement. The **Bangkok Khlong (Canal) Boat Tour** solves this completely: stepping directly onto a privately chartered, canopy-shaded teak longtail boat along the Chao Phraya riverfront, your group reclines on cushioned benches with cold Singha beers and chilled lemongrass towels as your captain steers through the water-gate into the quiet, shaded waterways of **Khlong Bangkok Noi** and **Khlong Bang Luang** in Thonburi.

## Royal Barges, Baan Silapin & Wat Paknam’s Giant Golden Buddha
* **Direct Riverfront Hotel Boarding:** Guests staying at [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/) step straight off the hotel’s private riverside deck onto their waiting longtail launch, while guests at [Sindhorn Kempinski](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) transfer 15 minutes to Sathorn Pier.
* **Three Iconic Canal Highlights:** Glide past wooden stilt houses, floating noodle boats, and orchids along Khlong Bang Luang to visit the 200-year-old *Baan Silapin (Artist’s House)*, marvel at the 69-meter bronze seated Buddha towering over the canal at *Wat Paknam Phasi Charoen*, and disembark at sunset opposite *Wat Arun* for riverside cocktails before boarding the [Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise](/destinations/thailand/thailand-nightlife-chao-phraya-princess-cruise/).

## Seamless Evening Transition From the Canals to Riverside Dining
Because your private longtail charter concludes along the Chao Phraya River between [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/) and Sathorn Pier around 5:30 PM, your group can step straight ashore for sunset cocktails overlooking Wat Arun or return to [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) after a restful afternoon between championship rounds at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), and [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/).

faqs.q: Can our private Thonburi Khlong boat pick us up directly at Riva Surya Bangkok?
faqs.a: Yes. Because Riva Surya Bangkok sits directly on the Chao Phraya River on Phra Athit Road, your private teak longtail boat can collect your golf group right at the hotel pier and cross straight into the Thonburi canal network.

faqs.q: Why is the Bangkok Khlong Boat Tour ideal for the afternoon of an 18-hole golf day?
faqs.a: The entire 3-hour excursion is seated beneath a shaded boat canopy with cool river breezes and chilled refreshments, giving your legs complete rest after walking the fairways at Thai Country Club, Ballyshear, or Alpine.

faqs.q: What landmarks do we see on a private Thonburi canal tour in Bangkok?
faqs.a: Your captain navigates Khlong Bangkok Noi and Khlong Bang Luang past traditional teak stilt homes, the Royal Barges Museum, the 200-year-old Baan Silapin Artist's House, the giant 69-meter golden Buddha at Wat Paknam, and Wat Arun.
